stem: What was one effect of rock and roll music on U.S. society during the 1950s?

options.label: A
options.text: Fewer musicians gave live musical performances.

options.label: B
options.text: People were exposed to more diverse musical styles.

options.label: C
options.text: Music stores sold fewer musical instruments.

options.label: D
options.text: Many religious groups actively supported the new musical culture.
